description: This PHP source file defines the RefreshTokenRepository class, which implements the OAuth2 server's refresh token handling logic, including persisting new tokens, revoking tokens, checking revocation status, and creating new token entities for the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: RefreshTokenRepository
classes.description: Repository class implementing OAuth2 refresh token operations, including persistence, revocation, and retrieval, extending BaseDao and implementing RefreshTokenRepositoryInterface.

methods.name: persistNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Persists a new refresh token entity into the database, converting it into an OAuthRefreshToken entity and handling unique constraint violations.

methods.name: revokeRefreshToken
methods.description: Marks a specified refresh token as revoked in the database.

methods.name: isRefreshTokenRevoked
methods.description: Checks whether a specific refresh token has been revoked.

methods.name: getNewRefreshToken
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of RefreshTokenEntity.
